tasks.label: Prepare FinAdvisor
tasks.detail: Creates missing .env files, installs the website's packages on first run, starts Ollama if it is not running

windows.command: if (-not (Test-Path .env)) { Copy-Item .env.example .env }; if (-not (Test-Path web/.env.local)) { Copy-Item web/.env.example web/.env.local }; if (-not (Test-Path web/node_modules)) { npm --prefix web install }; try { Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2 http://localhost:11434/api/tags | Out-Null; 'Ollama is running.' } catch { if (Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Start-Process ollama -ArgumentList serve -WindowStyle Hidden; 'Started Ollama.' } else { 'Ollama is not installed: chat explanations will be missing (see docs/SETUP.md step 4).' } }

tasks.command: [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; [ -f web/.env.local ] || cp web/.env.example web/.env.local; [ -d web/node_modules ] || npm --prefix web install; curl -s -o /dev/null http://localhost:11434/api/tags && echo 'Ollama is running.' || { command -v ollama >/dev/null && { nohup ollama serve >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo 'Started Ollama.'; } || echo 'Ollama is not installed: chat explanations will be missing (see docs/SETUP.md step 4).'; }

tasks.label: Build website for the public link
tasks.detail: Builds web/ so the API can serve it; VITE_API_URL=/ makes it call the API on the same address
